# mafs_gf_search_v2/ input provenance

## Hardened Phase 2 GF Regression Replay — input reuse note

This v2 workspace is the GF regression replay against the
Phase 2 hardened Skill (portable ZIP SHA
`a0c1cc6cef0947bdd1f4719f7d4ebb9252236c9f71cb544cd8c9b6b6fba4ca7f`).

Per `MAINTENANCE_ADVISORY_v0.2` section 6, regression compares
**semantic state** (not byte-level JSON hashes), and the CQC narrative
inputs are explicitly out of the test surface (they are pre-populated
by the operator, not produced by the Skill). For this replay we
reuse the v1 narrative inputs:

- `srp.json`            : copied from
   `I:\u6709\u8da3\u7684\u9879\u76ee\mafs_gf_search\srp.json`
   SHA `cf87b6876485a13d228af8b4158938c4c9bde4b1ef5dbb10d448a2c3ac54148a`
- `budget_envelope.json`: copied from same v1 workspace
   SHA `46e2f57a1d49b33262af7383d2dc93c8f9893d10004da9e30a827d0415c6c64f`
- `cqs.json`            : regenerated at run time by `run_mafs_gf.py` from
   `CQC/examples/outputs/cqs_A_gf_em.json` (the same source the v1
   run used). The driver's `build_binding()` does:
       src_cqs = CQC_REPO / "examples" / "outputs" / "cqs_A_gf_em.json"
       cqs.write_bytes(src_cqs.read_bytes())

## What the Skill controls (in this workspace)

- `cqs.json`                   (regenerated by driver; byte-identical to v1 because
                                the CQC example file is the same)
- `integration_binding.json`   (produced by `adapter.build_binding`)
- `discovery_candidate_pointers.json`
                              (produced by MAFS live discovery)
- `resolved_canonical_evidence.json`
                              (produced by MAFS live resolve; new evidence_id
                               values derived from canonical DOI + title per
                               `scripts/derive_evidence_id.py`)

The v1 run wrote a 7,922-byte `SKILL.md` (no `description` field)
that the agent had to manually patch on DSH. The v2 run ships the
new 7,922-byte `SKILL.md` (with `description` field, byte-identical
in body length, +1 field in frontmatter). v1 and v2 both work on
the same task; the v2 DSH install does NOT require the post-install
manual patch.
